requirements: Open and fund a new personal Associated Bank checking account by October 31, 2026 (Associated Access Checking requires a $25 minimum opening deposit; Associated Balanced or Choice Checking requires $100)

Receive recurring direct deposits totaling $500 or more within 90 days of account opening from an employer or government agency (person-to-person payments and transfers from existing or external accounts do not qualify)

Bonus tier is determined by the average daily balance of all open Associated Bank deposit accounts for days 31-90: $1,000-$4,999.99 earns $300, $5,000-$9,999.99 earns $400, $10,000 and over earns $600
Bonus is deposited into the new checking account within 120 days of account opening
Account must remain open for a minimum of 12 months or the bonus may be deducted at closing
Open a SoFi Checking and Savings account (new and existing members who have never set up direct deposit with SoFi are eligible)
Set up your first eligible direct deposit of $1 or more; SoFi must receive it on or before December 31, 2026
SoFi totals all eligible direct deposits received within 25 calendar days of the first eligible direct deposit: $1,000-$4,999.99 earns a $50 bonus, $5,000 or more earns a $400 bonus
Eligible direct deposits are deposits from an employer, payroll, or benefits provider via ACH (check deposits, P2P transfers such as Venmo/PayPal, and merchant transactions do not qualify)
Bonus is credited within 7 business days of meeting requirements
Apply and find out your offer; eligible applicants may earn as high as 200,000 Membership Rewards points after spending $15,000 in eligible purchases in the first 3 months of card membership
Welcome offers vary by applicant and you may not be eligible for an offer
Points valued up to ~$4,000 at 2.0 cents per point (TPG September 2026 Membership Rewards valuation)
Restricted to one welcome bonus per card per lifetime with American Express
Earn 75,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening
Points valued ~$1,538 at 2.05 cents per point (TPG July 2026 Ultimate Rewards valuation); worth 1.5 cents per point when redeemed for travel through Chase Travel
No annual fee waiver for first year; bonus not available if you received a Sapphire new cardmember bonus in the past 48 months
Earn 60,000 bonus points after spending $4,000 on purchases within the first 3 months from account opening
Points valued ~$1,050 at 1.75 cents per point (TPG September 2026 Wells Fargo Rewards valuation); issuer advertises $600 toward travel
$50 annual statement credit with a minimum $50 airline purchase
